messages:
mike: kicking off staged rollout v7.3.0 -> 10% to ap-southeast-1 (asia1). deploy-bot starting canary now. change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. watching 5xx and p95. tagging oncall @sara. if 5xx >= +3% sustained for 5m or p95 > 250ms, hold and pin

deploy-bot: canary action started: 
  - target: ap-southeast-1
  - traffic: 10%
  - version: v7.3.0
  - started_at: 1799998001
:rocket:

raj: pulling metrics. any custom routes for asia1? I'll watch kv-cache and pod restarts

carol: quick note — release notes PR #456 updated with feature list and migration steps. will add rollback plan in a sec

sara: oncall here, thanks. watching dashboards. will escalate if visible error spike. please call hold explicitly if you want me to stop traffic

mike: calling hold if we see above thresholds. for clarity: hold = pin traffic back to v7.2.9 for that region + scale down canary pods. rollback only if hold condition persists 5m

raj: small blip at 1799998050 — 5xx +1.8% in asia1, not yet at threshold but p95 trending up. checking logs

carol: seeing repeated kv-cache OOM on 2/6 canary pods around 1799998065. log snippet: 
```
E 03:07:08 redis: eviction triggered, mem_used 98%, process restarted
E 03:07:09 app: failed to fetch cache, falling back to DB
```

nora: start quick smoke eval on v7.2.9 in asia1 while we decide. will post results in 5m

mike: okay sounds risky. request: HOLD and PIN region. @deploy-bot, pin asia1 back to v7.2.9 and halt rollout increments. do NOT promote to 25%

deploy-bot: received HOLD command. executing pin and scale actions now.
- pin: route asia1 -> v7.2.9
- scale: canary pods scaled 0->2 for graceful drain
- estimated drain time: ~3m

ops-bot: rollback runbook triggered: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback. note: drain may briefly increase latency.

sara: confirmed hold. will notify incident channel if 5xx crosses 3% or p95 > 250ms after rollback starts. :eyes:

raj: I increased redis maxmemory on canary hosts and raised eviction threshold, but since we're pinning we'll monitor for regressions.

deploy-bot: pin complete at 1799998110. rollback in progress, will post final status.

nora: smoke eval on v7.2.9 done: basic traces ✅, sample perf p95 170ms, no new 5xx in sample set

carol: adding hold/rollback notes to PR #456 and will schedule a quick postmortem after cutover.

mike: decision summary: hold + pin asia1 to v7.2.9, abort further percent increases. infra to investigate kv-cache changes and we will re-run canary once mitigations validated. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollback finished at 1799998155. traffic restored to v7.2.9 in asia1. canary pods drained. logs: https://deploys.redwood/internal/1799998001

sara: monitoring, marking thread as "hold enacted". will reopen if signal resurfaces.

mike: will convene postmortem tomorrow 09:00 UTC. please add any timeline notes here before EOD.
